items.title: What is ethical hacking?
items.response: Ethical hacking is when security experts test computer systems to find weaknesses before bad actors can exploit them. It is used to improve protection and help companies fix security problems.

items.title: What is jailbreaking?
items.response: Jailbreaking is the process of removing restrictions on a device, such as a phone or tablet. It is studied in security courses to understand the risks and why manufacturers put protections in place.
